questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings warns drivers that a bridge ahead may be too narrow to safely pass a truck. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic from the right is merging into your lane. Be ready to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow warning sign alerts you that a divided highway is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Only cross after any trains have passed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign indicates that the road will make a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road is about to turn sharply at a severe angle. Slow down and prepare for the sharp change in direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn at an extreme angle in the direction shown. Slow down as if you are making a turn at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a barrier between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a lane is ending. Traffic must move to the left to continue.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: The road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells drivers to watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and oncoming vehicles cross first. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way. Turn around carefully to avoid a head-on collision.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign shows a crosswalk. Be alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is a traffic law you must obey. It means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is eight-sided. You must come to a complete stop and wait until the way is clear before driving through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts drivers to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign means stop. Come to a complete stop at the marked line, crosswalk, or intersection. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You may see it at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be near or on the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. This sign alerts you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black symbols. They alert you to hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a road crossing ahead will create an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through construction areas.
